profile_username_note: Usernames can't be changed because they're part of your course URLs.
profile_password_note: Changing it signs out every other browser you are logged in on. API keys keep working; revoke those on the API keys tab.
profile_security_note: Sign out of every device and browser where you're logged in.
profile_api_keys_note: Used by the CLI and grading bots to authenticate as you.
profile_api_keys_guide: New to the CLI? See the getting started guide →
profile_api_key_created: New key created. Copy it now. It won't be shown again.
profile_calendar_note: A private link that your calendar app (Google Calendar, Thunderbird, your phone) subscribes to. It lists the meetings and published exams of your courses and keeps itself up to date.
profile_calendar_warning: Anyone with this link can read your calendar. Generating a new link means the previous link stops working at once.
